ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: The query is a clean mathematical evaluation (note: it's the binomial expansion of (101−1)⁴ = 100⁴ = 100,000,000), with no harm-adjacent content that would make the two models' differing aversion profiles relevant. So I routed purely on capability, where Willet clearly outperforms Curlew on the benchmarks most predictive of quantitative reasoning quality (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 74.8, GPQA Diamond 64.1 vs 54.3, Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 81.4). All other factors—cost, latency, context window—are identical across the fleet, so the capability gap is the deciding factor.
